verdict.rationale: Temporal supports event-driven triggers via Signals/Queries/Updates for external events, Schedules for time-based triggers, and automatic retry policies that react to failure events — all of which let developers build code that reacts automatically to events. However, this is imperative/code-based (write a Workflow with signal handlers) rather than a declarative 'if event then action' rule-definition interface, which the story implies. Missing for 10: a declarative rules/condition authoring layer (not just code-based signal/schedule handlers), and independent evidence of AI-native users actually using these primitives as 'rules'.
